ports.name: clk_i

ports.name: rstn_i

ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in csr_pmpcfg, csr_pmpaddr, addr_masking and fault_check

ports.name: csr_o

ports.evidence: fault_check process assigns fault_o <= (not ctrl_i.cpu_debug) and fail(0) on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: pmpcfg
signals.functionality: Holds per-region 8-bit PMP configuration written from CSR write data under pmpcfg_we enable; its fields (R/W/X/L/mode) are read by matching and permission logic.
signals.evidence: csr_pmpcfg process writes pmpcfg from ctrl_i.csr_wdata when pmpcfg_we(i/4)='1'; pmpcfg used in cfg_rd assignment, perm_gen, match_gen, and pmpaddr write condition

signals.name: pmpcfg_we
signals.functionality: Combinational vector derived from CSR address and write enable that enables writing groups of pmpcfg bytes; gates pmpcfg updates per-index.
role: decodes CSR writes to cfg registers
signals.evidence: csr_we_cfg process sets pmpcfg_we based on ctrl_i.csr_addr(1 downto 0) and ctrl_i.csr_we

signals.name: pmpaddr
signals.functionality: Holds per-region address values written from CSR write data under pmpaddr_we and pmpcfg L bits; its stored values are read back and used in matching comparisons.
signals.evidence: csr_pmpaddr process writes pmpaddr from ctrl_i.csr_wdata when pmpaddr_we(i)='1'; address_read_back reads pmpaddr to form addr_rd; addr_mask_napot_gen and addr_match_rn_gen read pmpaddr

signals.name: pmpaddr_we
signals.functionality: Combinational vector derived from CSR address and write enable that enables writing individual pmpaddr entries in their clocked process.
role: decodes CSR writes to address registers
signals.evidence: csr_we_addr process sets pmpaddr_we based on ctrl_i.csr_addr(3 downto 0) and ctrl_i.csr_we

signals.name: cfg_rd
signals.functionality: Combinational copies of pmpcfg entries used to build 32-bit readback words; each cfg_rd(i) is assigned directly from pmpcfg(i).

signals.name: cfg_rd32
signals.functionality: Combines four cfg_rd bytes into XLEN-bit words used for CSR readback; fed to csr_read_access to drive csr_o when CSR selection requests configuration readback.
signals.evidence: cfg_rd32(i) <= cfg_rd(i*4+3) & ... & cfg_rd(i*4+0); csr_read_access uses cfg_rd32 to assign csr_o

signals.name: addr_rd
signals.functionality: Constructs readback address words from stored pmpaddr with LSB adjustments according to granularity and mode; used to drive csr_o on CSR read of address registers.
signals.evidence: address_read_back assigns addr_rd(i) from pmpaddr(i) with LSB adjustments; csr_read_access uses addr_rd to drive csr_o

signals.name: acc_addr
signals.functionality: Combinationally selects either the CPU next PC or the LSU address based on lsu_mo_we, supplying the address used by matching (cmp_na,cmp_ge,cmp_lt).
signals.evidence: acc_addr <= ctrl_i.pc_nxt when (ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we = '0') else addr_ls_i; cmp_na and cmp_ge/lt use acc_addr in comparisons

signals.name: acc_priv
signals.functionality: Combinationally selects CPU or LSU privilege (cpu_priv or lsu_priv) based on lsu_mo_we and supplies the privilege used by perm_gen to compute allow per region.
signals.evidence: acc_priv <= ctrl_i.cpu_priv when (ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we = '0') else ctrl_i.lsu_priv; perm_gen reads acc_priv

signals.name: addr_mask_napot
signals.functionality: Combinationally generates per-region masks for NAPOT addressing from pmpaddr bits (or is zeros when NAP_EN disabled); optionally used to form addr_mask when region in NAPOT mode.
role: sources addr_mask when NAP mode enabled
signals.evidence: addr_mask_napot_gen computes entries from pmpaddr(r)(i-3); addr_masking copies addr_mask_napot into addr_mask when cfg_al_c='1'

signals.name: addr_mask
signals.functionality: Clocked register that holds the mask used for NAPOT matching; on reset cleared, updated to addr_mask_napot when region NAPOT bit is set, otherwise set to all ones (or zero if NAP_EN disabled).
signals.evidence: addr_masking process assigns addr_mask <= addr_mask_napot or (others=>'1') on rising_edge(clk_i) depending on pmpcfg(r)(cfg_al_c)

signals.name: cmp_na
signals.functionality: Combinational per-region signal that indicates address equality under mask (NAPOT) when NAP_EN is true; computed from acc_addr, addr_mask and pmpaddr and used by match_gen.
signals.evidence: cmp_na(r) <= '1' when ((acc_addr(...) and addr_mask(r)) = (pmpaddr(r)(...) and addr_mask(r))) and NAP_EN else '0'

signals.name: cmp_ge
signals.functionality: Combinational per-region signal indicating acc_addr >= pmpaddr(r-1) (or constant for r=0) when TOR_EN is enabled; used by match_gen to determine TOR matches.
signals.evidence: addr_match_rn_gen assigns cmp_ge(r) using unsigned(acc_addr(...)) >= unsigned(pmpaddr(r-1)(...)) when TOR_EN

signals.name: cmp_lt
signals.functionality: Combinational per-region signal indicating acc_addr < pmpaddr(r) (or constant for r=0) when TOR_EN is enabled; used by match_gen to determine TOR matches.
signals.evidence: addr_match_rn_gen assigns cmp_lt(r) using unsigned(acc_addr(...)) < unsigned(pmpaddr(r)(...)) when TOR_EN

signals.name: match
signals.functionality: Combinational per-region signal that indicates whether the access hits the region (TOR or NAPOT), computed from pmpcfg mode fields and cmp_ge/cmp_lt/cmp_na, and used to select which region's allow affects fail chain.
signals.evidence: match_gen process computes match(r) from pmpcfg(r)(mode) and cmp_ge/cmp_lt/cmp_na; fail(r) uses match(r) to select update

signals.name: allow
signals.functionality: Combinational per-region signal that indicates whether the current access is permitted (R/W/X) based on pmpcfg bits and acc_priv and the type of access selected by lsu_mo_we/lsu_rw.
signals.evidence: perm_gen process assigns allow(r) from pmpcfg(r)(cfg_*) and acc_priv depending on ctrl_i.lsu_mo_we and ctrl_i.lsu_rw

signals.name: fail
signals.functionality: Combinational vector that folds per-region matches and permissions into a single chain: fail(NUM_REGIONS) is set from acc_priv then each fail(r) becomes not allow(r) if match(r) else next fail, producing fail(0) used to raise a fault.
role: carries failing result to fault logic
signals.evidence: fail(NUM_REGIONS) <= '1' when (acc_priv /= priv_mode_m_c) else '0'; for r downto 0, fail(r) <= not allow(r) when (match(r)='1') else fail(r+1); fault_check samples fail(0)
